sections.description: Registry anchor for protocol bindings (ADR-0030, ADR-0054): not authorable.

The HTTP method and path of an operation, declared only to override the derived ones. A query is `GET`, a command `POST`; the path is `/<collection>/{id}/<operation-kebab>` for an operation with a target key and `/<collection>/<operation-kebab>` without one. Most models never write it. Experimental since 1.3.0: the shape may change in a MINOR, including removals and renames (docs/compatibility-policy.md).
sections.whenToUse: An operation must keep a method or path the derived one would not give it, such as an existing public URL.

attrs.name: method
attrs.description: The HTTP method. Absent: GET for a query, POST for a command.

attrs.name: path
attrs.description: A path template. Its `{name}` placeholders must be exactly the target's primary key fields when the operation is keyed, and there must be none when it is not; two declared bindings of one API may not share the method and path (ERR_BINDING_PATH_MISMATCH).
